commits.message: fix(apply): the click arm owns its idle bracket; one asker spelling; branded click verb; monotonic wait end (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.scr)

feat(apply): every click, idle close and request reaches state through one exhaustive arm table (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.1dh.scr)

A closed Event union (request, click, menu-idle) and ARMS, an arm record keyed
by every kind, are the one consumer of the journal's turn. A new kind fails to
build until its arm exists. The request takes no turn yet: a click holds the
turn across its launches, so its writes join once launches become effects.

feat(sources): a failed shell read carries the command's stderr; the launcher names its timeout (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.dr2) (#615)

* feat(sources): a failed shell read carries the command's stderr; the launcher names its timeout (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.dr2)

A shell source's failed read now ends in what the command wrote to
stderr, trimmed and shown by its last 2000 characters, on every arm but
an output flood or a failed pipe. A timeout result carries
`timed out after N s` from the launch's own bound, so the shell reader
and the daemon's runs read it instead of spelling it from constants of
their own.

* refactor(launch): one describer says why a launch failed and what the child said, for every caller (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.dr2)

Review findings: callers ranked stderr, reason and error differently, so a
timed-out click dropped the timeout, a timed-out tmux or doctor probe dropped
its stderr, a rate-limited read repeated its tag, a signal kill named no
signal, and a failed read could draw 2000 characters inline. The launcher now
owns the text: why, plus the last stderr line bounded by code point.

* refactor(launch): failures carry whole stderr and the ⚠ cell bounds its line; clicks, plugin install and the handler probe share the describer (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.dr2)

Medium review: keeping only stderr's last line lost git's fatal and ps's
error before its usage; the display bound belongs where the line is drawn,
so the broken cell clips through the render layer's sanitizer and the viewer
keeps the whole text. Lane failures keep stdout, where their tools explain.
Spawn errors drop the internal tag; clicks and handoffs say why one way.

* fix(launch): a failure says the first and last lines of what its child said, bounded where it is built (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.dr2)

Second high review: the live daemon wires no segment-error viewer, so the bar's
⚠ cell is the only place a failure shows and clipping it there hid the cause.
The cell draws whole again; the describer bounds the said text instead, which
also keeps megabytes of stderr out of the store and the memory-report log.
Lane failures summarize stdout the same way and drop it for floods and cut
pipes. The handoff's timeout no longer names a bound it did not set. Install
and tmux's rate-limit go through the describer.
test(facts): name the doctor's closure tests for what they protect (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.xb3)
fix(facts): the wait's comment names every session; the doctor's namespace-read test returns (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.xb3)

chore(facts): delete the wants closure (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.xb3)

The facts document is total, so the question "which fields does this config
read" has no caller with a reason. Every session now gathers every built-in:
git runs one constant option set (forge lookup included), every declared
plugin source is held, and burn, block and autocompact's context cap are always
composed. A view's declaration depends on the request alone, so a preset pick
moves no hold.

Deleted: the wants function, the needed-prefix builders, the sources-read walk,
the closure parameter through declare/refresh/read/project, the PR reads gate,
the git options derived from the closure, `Gathered`, `declaredSources`, and the
view's preset reaction. The doctor's data-needs walk stays and now owns its own
per-segment path closure, since it answers what a config would read.

The bar is byte-identical; the payload golden gains the keys that were gated
(block, burn, metrics, activity, tmux and the like on presets that did not read
them). Tests that asserted gating are deleted; the fold-edge cases they covered
(partials, helpers handed a dict) move to the doctor's path closure.
